findings.message: Every order total now has a hard-coded 499 cents added on top of the cart subtotal. Nothing in the coupon spec asks for this, so every customer would be silently overcharged.
findings.suggestion: return { id, userId: cart.userId, totalCents: subtotalCents(cart) };

criteria.note: Implemented with Math.max(0, subtotal - couponCents), but no test covers the subtraction or the clamp at zero.

scope_creep.message: Adds an unexplained fixed 499-cent charge to every order total, which the coupon spec does not ask for.
